names.primary: Muzeul Național al Satului Dimitrie Gusti
common: Muzeul Național al Satului Dimitrie Gusti

source_tags: Professor Dimitrie Gusti, after 10 years of researches and ground aquisitions, had the idea to found the museum. The initial siting designs were executed by Victor Ion Popa. Between 1948 and 1978 the museum was managed by professor Gh. Focsa.

Ideea infiintarii a fost a prof. Dimitrie Gusti, dupa 10 ani de cercetari si achizitii pe teren. Planurile de amplasament initiale au fost executate de Victor Ion Popa. in perioada 1948 - l978, conducerea muzeului a fost asigurata de prof. Gh. Focsa.
